name: Arrow–Pratt risk-aversion coefficients A(x)=−u''/u', R(x)=−xu''/u'; CARA⇔constant A, CRRA⇔constant R
description: Arrow-Pratt absolute/relative risk-aversion coefficients A and R; CARA/CRRA/log constancy; links to acceptance-set translation and Kelly log-growth.

code.lean:
import MathFin.RiskMeasures.RiskAversion

open MathFin
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- Arrow-Pratt absolute/relative risk-aversion coefficients A and R; CARA/CRRA/log constancy; links to acceptance-set translation and Kelly log-growth. -/
theorem mf_riskmeasures_arrow_pratt_risk_aversion  :
    (∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → ∀ (x : ℝ),
        absoluteRiskAversion (fun x => - Real.exp (-(a * x))) x = a) ∧
    (∀ (γ : ℝ), 0 < γ → γ ≠ 1 → ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x →
        relativeRiskAversion (fun x => Real.rpow x (1 - γ) / (1 - γ)) x = γ) ∧
    (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → relativeRiskAversion Real.log x = 1) ∧
    (∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a →
        Monotone (fun x => - Real.exp (-(a * x))) ∧
        ∀ {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
          ∀ (W : ℝ) (X : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
            acceptableUnderUtility s p (fun x => - Real.exp (-(a * x))) W X →
            acceptableUnderUtility s p (fun x => - Real.exp (-(a * x))) W (fun i => X i + c)) ∧
    (∀ (p : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → ∀ (b f : ℝ),
        kellyGrowth p b f = ∫ x, Real.log x ∂(kellyReturnMeasure p b f)) :=
  MathFin.arrow_pratt_risk_aversion_constancy_and_links
